title: Pure offline deterministic Solana ChainFM address directory cleaning CLI
objective: Implement a pure offline, deterministic SOL address directory cleaning CLI that parses sol_address_labels.json (canonical) and sol_addresses.txt (cross-check), normalizes Solana addresses, cleans labels without inference, and outputs sanitized results to an external output directory.
forbidden_actions: Do not perform network calls or credential access.
Do not write to database, cache, or external storage.
Do not copy external address/label files into Git or repository fixtures.
Do not print raw full addresses or label text in reports or logs.
Do not modify BSC, multi-chain, or trading logic.
